author: Izluiszi
quote: GTA 6 has a good heart. The world feels alive and some missions are fun. But the problems are hard to ignore.There is no PC port, so you are stuck on consoles. The game also lacks fluidity. It stutters and drops frames, giving me headaches after long play sessions. A game this big should run **** also pushes a lot of woke content. There are forcedmoment where can only think that they fear not appealing everyone, so toned down things that made this series good. This pulls you out of the **** press gives it 100s while admitting it is not perfect. That feels odd. The game could have been great, but Rockstar never fixed these **** its core GTA 6 is still good. The lack of a PC version, poor performance, and heavy woke messaging hold it back. That is why it only gets a 0.
